class.name: AudioEffectSteamReflectionHRTF
class.brief_description: HRTF-decodes submitted Ambisonic reflections and mixes them with the incoming dry stereo signal.
class.description: Place this effect after [AudioEffectSteamSpatial]. It receives the point-HRTF dry stereo signal through the normal Godot effect chain, retrieves Ambisonic blocks submitted by one or more [AudioEffectSteamReflectionSend] resources, rotates the sound field using [member listener_orientation], decodes it binaurally, and adds the wet stereo result to the dry input. The resource itself owns four dynamically sized float arrays, one for each first-order Ambisonic channel. This is why sends target this resource rather than an [AudioEffectSteamReflectionHRTFInstance]. The native [code]mix_in()[/code] entry point copy-adds first-order four-channel Steam Audio blocks directly into those arrays, without a sidecar state object or exposing multichannel data through Godot's stereo [AudioFrame] interface.

members.member: Absolute world orientation of the listener. The decoder rotates the world-aligned Ambisonic field into head-relative coordinates before HRTF rendering.
Nonnegative linear gain applied to the decoded wet stereo signal before it is added to the ordinary input.
